issues.description: The exercise title and repository project names refer to different exercise identifiers: problem_statement.md names the task 'H02E02 - Panic at Seal Saloon' while the template repository's settings.gradle sets rootProject.name to 'H04E01---Panic-at-Burger-House' and the solution repository's settings.gradle uses 'H04E01---Panic-at-Burger-House-Solution'. This inconsistent naming of the same exercise/project across artifacts can confuse students about which repository or exercise they are working on and makes cross-referencing instructions, examples, and repository metadata harder.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the exercise/project identifier across artifacts. Either update problem_statement.md to use the repository project name (e.g., 'Panic at Burger House') or, preferably, set rootProject.name in both template and solution settings.gradle files to match the problem title 'H02E02 - Panic at Seal Saloon' so students see a consistent name in the repository and the assignment description.
